family_analysis.method: shared planning/collection Hoeffding bounds grouped by immutable PUB identity
assumptions: independent stationary repetitions; arbitrary dependence among replicas and members within each PUB shot
union bounds across PUBs; no independence assumption between PUBs or jobs
directional rejection uses the one-sided alpha radius; displayed intervals use the two-sided alpha radius

floor.rule: the floor is the larger of the root-mean-square, over informative diagnostic qubits, of the readout-corrected unitary N = 16 residual (observed minus the analysis model) taken over all of them and over the main qubits alone; statistical noise stays in

t2_pattern.drive_dephasing_lead: positive rank correlation of residual with T2, negative residuals on short T2
